Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.edit

Interface EditSession

All Known Implementing Classes:
EditSession.Unavailable
@Incubating @CubismEditor(from="5.1.02", to="5.3.99") public interface EditSession
An admitted editing session on one model document — the Turboism equivalent of the span between the official EditBegin and EditEnd requests.

While a session is open the editor locks its editing UI and operations run inside a single undoable transaction; close() commits (one history entry may be recorded) and cancel() restores the pre-session model state. Exactly one session can be open per document at a time.

Operations are grouped into five families reachable through the accessor methods: parameterKeys(), parameterStructure(), selection(), partObjects(), and deformers().

Every method on a session that is not EditSessionState.OPEN fails closed: work after cancellation raises EditCancelledException, work after close or on unavailable() raises EditUnavailableException.
